conf.description: entra-id audit dataset, json format: parsing deferred entirely to the Azure Logs integration (azure.auditlogs data stream). Thin pipeline: filters the shared Event Hub feed to the AuditLogs category, lifts the User-Agent out of the additionalDetails key/value array, and tags event.dataset.

conf.comment: entra-id / audit / json: single AuditLogs diagnostic category on the same Event Hub as the other three datasets. Parsing (initiatingBy/caller IP mapping, properties.result -> event.outcome) is left to the Azure Logs integration -- do not re-implement it. The one actionable field-table transform pre-Elasticsearch is extracting the User-Agent that additionalDetails buries as a generic key/value pair, since the stock pipeline never does this. Cribl's expression language forbids function/arrow declarations ('cannot have nested scopes' / 'cannot have any declarations', confirmed against this instance), so the array search is a bounded ternary over the first 5 entries rather than a .find() callback -- additionalDetails is documented as a short key/value list, so this is expected to cover it in practice.

functions.description: document scope: thin pass-through, integration owns ECS mapping; note the no-function-scope constraint
identify the event: keep only the AuditLogs category on this shared Event Hub feed
extract User-Agent from the additionalDetails key/value array (first 5 entries checked) into user_agent.original, and tag event.dataset ahead of the integration's own parsing
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
